notes.title: New Version of "Fishing Girl's Fantasy"
notes.notes:
[olist]
A new Staff System has been introduced, allowing you to hire staff and enjoy "hands-off management" functionality—expand your restaurant to your heart's content now!



More vibrant guest avatars have been added; stay tuned for subsequent storylines to unfold.



Optimizations have been made to task progression pacing and numerical gameplay experience.



Visual art for cafeteria scenes has been enhanced.



New background music has been added to cafeteria scenes.
[/olist]
